column1: # How people actually type Odia in Latin letters, and what they mean by it.
# Two kinds of spelling are here, and neither is reachable from the phonetic
#  - Words the rules get wrong because Latin spelling does not carry the
#    difference: a long aa nobody doubles ("ame" is ଆମେ, "pani" is ପାଣି),
#    retroflex against dental ("bada" is ବଡ଼, "gote" is ଗୋଟେ), ଣ against ନ
#    ("kana" is କଣ), ଳ against ଲ ("sakala" is ସକାଳ), the word-opening ଯ that
#    is said "j" ("jiba" is ଯିବା, "jadi" is ଯଦି), and the nasal mark nobody
#    types ("mu" is ମୁଁ, "nahi" is ନାହିଁ, "pain" is ପାଇଁ).
#  - Chat shorthand that drops letters wholesale: "kn" for କଣ, "nhi" for
